label: post-registration second-review robustness and descriptive reanalysis
scope: same simulator and original 32 sessions; original results remain immutable
original_reanalysis: retain all original report denominators; add conditional flips among assessable unauthorized releases, positive-regret median/max, and exact gap quartiles as post-hoc descriptive endpoints

mixed_handoffs.probabilities: uniform independent operation sampling with replacement; order retained
mixed_handoffs.authority: revised contract, initial worker plan only; unpermitted remap uses an unchanged candidate

localization: exact slot-and-reason sets against pre-execution original single-operation witnesses; mixed-composition diagnostics retained without circular accuracy scoring

workflow.fresh: execute 12 revised pairs with full local receipt/replay gate, read back verified evidence, check/write panel
workflow.reuse: read/verify 8 unchanged original objects, replay each again into new reports, execute 4 unsupported pairs with the full gate, check/write panel
workflow.timing_boundary: starts before evidence loading and execution; ends after panel decision/numerical file write; old store construction excluded from both revision paths
workflow.add_candidate: separately validate an eight-slot two-candidate starting contract extended to the third supported candidate using the same timed new objects; no extra simulation or independent sample claimed
workflow.double_replicates: extend revised recipes from replicates 0..3 to 0..7; execute 12 new pairs per session; compare reused old half against independently fresh timed old slots, with new half shared by both constructed panels
workflow.failure_policy: retain every failure and rejected artifact; no retry or seed replacement

gap_strata: exact quartile cuts from the complete intended reference panels of each analysis universe; no incoming outcome used to choose cuts
interpretation: descriptive designed-case stress validation and one-host workflow timing; no operational fault-rate, human-user or population-optimal selection inference
